title: Sughra acha hi kiya
body:
Sughra acha hi kiya
Haye sughra..(2)

6. Haye paani lene ko tarai pe gaya tha saqqa phir alamdaar nahi sirf alam aaya tha

7. Maslehat kya thi tumhe le na gaye kyu sarwar

8. Haye kaise manzar wo kare mazharo irfan bayaa
